scorecard.name: Dinesh Personal Investment Scorecard
scorecard.description: Personal startup investment evaluation framework based on evidence, dimension-level scoring, confidence, risk and valuation discipline.

investor_profile.name: Dinesh
investor_profile.description: Evaluate startups based on founder quality, market opportunity, product-market fit, defensibility, commercial validation, economics, financial health, governance, valuation and investment risk. Missing information must not automatically be treated as negative evidence.

missing_information_rule.title: Missing Information Must Not Automatically Become Risk
rules: Do not convert missing information into a risk merely because the information is unavailable.
A risk requires negative or concerning evidence, or a documented condition that creates a material investment risk.
If information is simply unavailable, report it under missing_information instead.
Do not use absence of evidence as evidence of a negative condition.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the founding team has the capability, experience, complementary skills and commitment required to execute the proposed business.
evidence_required: Previous startup or execution history where available
do_not_assume: Do not infer execution capability from job title alone
Do not treat education or employer reputation as proof of startup execution ability
Do not treat founder claims as verified achievements without supporting evidence
Do not treat missing founder information as negative evidence

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional founder capability, complementary skills and execution evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_75_89: Strong founder and team capability with credible execution evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Reasonable capability with identifiable gaps or moderate uncertainty.
scoring_guidance.score_40_59: Material founder or team weaknesses affecting execution confidence.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Severe capability, commitment or execution concerns.

investor_preferences.notes: Founder quality is one of the primary investment considerations.Missing information must not automatically be treated as negative evidence or a risk.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the target market is sufficiently large, growing, accessible and structurally attractive to support a meaningful venture outcome.
do_not_assume: Founder-provided TAM is not automatically an established fact
Do not equate TAM with realistic obtainable revenue
Do not infer market size from current company revenue
Do not treat missing TAM evidence as proof of a small market

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional market opportunity strongly supported by credible evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_75_89: Strong market opportunity with credible supporting evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Reasonable market opportunity with meaningful limitations or uncertainty.
scoring_guidance.score_40_59: Weak or insufficiently demonstrated market opportunity.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Very limited, declining or poorly supported market opportunity.

investor_preferences.notes: Market claims should be evidence-driven rather than accepted solely from founder projections.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the product solves a meaningful customer problem and whether available evidence demonstrates product-market fit.
evidence_required: Usage or repeat-usage evidence where available
Retention or customer feedback where available
do_not_assume: Product existence is not proof of product-market fit
Revenue is not automatically proof of product-market fit
Customer count is not automatically proof of customer satisfaction
Do not treat management claims as PMF evidence without supporting data

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional product differentiation and compelling PMF evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_75_89: Strong product with credible evidence of customer value and PMF.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Promising product with incomplete or moderate PMF evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_40_59: Weak or insufficient evidence of product-market fit.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Poor product-market fit evidence or serious product concerns.

investor_preferences.notes: Separate product quality from actual customer validation.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the company has a durable technical or intellectual-property advantage that competitors cannot easily reproduce.
evaluate: Data or network effects where relevant
evidence_required: Patent or IP information where available
Evidence of switching costs or technical barriers where applicable
do_not_assume: Technology complexity is not automatically a moat
A patent does not automatically create commercial defensibility
Proprietary terminology is not evidence of proprietary technology
Do not infer defensibility without evidence of competitor difficulty

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional technology moat strongly supported by evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Moderate technology advantage with identifiable limitations.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Little or no identifiable technology moat.

investor_preferences.notes: Technology should be evaluated for actual defensibility rather than complexity alone.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate the strength, quality and durability of commercial validation demonstrated by revenue, customers, growth, retention and distribution.
do_not_assume: Revenue is not automatically proof of product-market fit
Customer count does not prove retention
Revenue growth does not automatically prove healthy economics
Do not infer diversified revenue without customer-level evidence
Missing retention data is not automatically evidence of poor retention

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional commercial validation with strong quality, growth and durability of revenue.
scoring_guidance.score_75_89: Strong commercial traction with credible customer validation.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Meaningful but still developing commercial traction.
scoring_guidance.score_40_59: Limited commercial validation or material traction concerns.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Minimal, unreliable or absent commercial validation.

investor_preferences.notes: Revenue quality, customer concentration and repeatability matter in addition to absolute revenue.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the business can generate attractive and scalable economics as it grows.
do_not_assume: Missing CAC is not proof of high CAC
Missing LTV is not proof of poor LTV
Revenue growth is not proof of healthy unit economics
Do not calculate unit economics from unsupported assumptions

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional unit economics with strong evidence of scalable profitability.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Reasonable economics with meaningful gaps or moderate uncertainty.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Poor or structurally unattractive unit economics.

investor_preferences.notes: Missing unit-economic data should reduce confidence rather than automatically create a negative score.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the company has sufficient financial resilience and discipline to reach its next meaningful milestone.
do_not_assume: Revenue does not prove profitability
Do not infer runway without cash and burn evidence
Do not infer financial health from fundraising alone
Missing financial data is not automatically evidence of poor financial health

scoring_guidance.score_75_89: Strong financial position with good resilience.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Acceptable financial position with some limitations.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Severe financial weakness or sustainability concerns.

investor_preferences.notes: Use deterministic financial metrics as authoritative inputs; AI interprets rather than recalculates them.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether ownership, governance and investor protections provide a healthy and investable structure.
do_not_assume: Do not infer ownership from job titles
Missing SHA is not proof of an unfavorable SHA
Do not assume investor protections without documentation
Founder concentration is not automatically negative without considering context

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Excellent governance and transparent, investor-compatible ownership structure.

investor_preferences.notes: Founder concentration, ESOP, governance quality and investor protections should receive explicit attention.

evaluation_spec.objective: Evaluate whether the proposed entry valuation and deal terms are attractive relative to traction, growth, business quality and investment risk.
evaluate: Liquidation or conversion terms where relevant
do_not_assume: Low valuation is not automatically attractive
High valuation is not automatically unattractive
Do not assume future growth without evidence
Do not treat founder valuation expectations as fair market value
Do not infer investor rights when they are undocumented

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Exceptional entry valuation and highly attractive terms strongly supported by evidence.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Reasonable valuation with notable concerns or uncertainty.
scoring_guidance.score_40_59: Expensive or materially unfavorable valuation or terms.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Highly unattractive valuation or deal terms.

investor_preferences.notes: Prefer validated businesses with reasonable entry valuation and documented investor protections.

evaluation_spec.objective: Identify material cross-dimensional investment risks and evaluate whether a credible pathway exists to an attractive future exit.
evidence_required: Customer or supplier concentration information where available
Potential strategic or financial exit pathways where available
positive_signals: Clear path to future financing or liquidity
do_not_assume: Absence of identified risk is not proof of absence of risk
Do not assume an exit will occur
Do not infer exit value without supporting evidence
Do not duplicate a risk merely to increase its apparent importance

scoring_guidance.score_90_100: Low material risk and strong plausible exit potential.
scoring_guidance.score_75_89: Manageable risks with attractive potential exit pathways.
scoring_guidance.score_60_74: Moderate risks and uncertain exit potential.
scoring_guidance.score_40_59: Material risks or weak exit visibility.
scoring_guidance.score_0_39: Severe risks and limited plausible exit pathways.

investor_preferences.notes: Focus on material investment risks rather than generic startup risks.
